cautions: The 3GPP protocol was locked before generating and evaluating the 3GPP dataset, but after observing the DeepMIMO branch result.
Fresh simulation drops support source separation but do not prove statistical independence.
No GPP_V12 outcome has been observed or used to tune this dataset.
Finite ZF/RZF candidate validation is not global beamforming optimality.
provenance.channel_units: Absolute complex Sionna frequency response at zero baseband subcarrier; pathloss and shadow fading enabled; no channel normalization; noise fixed by V12 at 2e-13 W
provenance.generation_method: Sionna 2.2.0 official UMi implementation; 3GPP TR 38.901 V19.2; PyTorch CPU; single-sector topology; fixed seed 20261112; 16-element BS panel and single-antenna UEs
provenance.group_definition: 160 independent topology drops; one group identifier per four-user geometry
provenance.independence_basis: Fresh Sionna 3GPP UMi simulation source and seed, distinct from the DeepMIMO ray-tracing development and test scenarios; each geometry is a newly generated drop
